description: Sanitized reference requirements derived from selected RFP chunks. Verbatim source text and evidence have been removed.

source_scope.note: This is a selected evaluation subset, not an exhaustive representation of the source RFPs.

requirements.text: Bidders must report discrepancies in the RfS within the specified period after issuance.
Bidders must independently assess, verify, and validate the provided information before submitting bids.
The bidder is responsible for all costs associated with preparation and submission of the bid.
Solar power may only be sold to eligible beneficiary department connections under the specified VNM arrangement during the agreement tenure.
The selected SPG is responsible for design, survey, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and O&M for the specified contract period.
The solar power plants, associated 11kV line, and RMS must be installed under the specified RESCO arrangement.
Bidders must quote the tariff on a firm basis without price variation.
The bidder must furnish bid security for the quoted capacity.
The bidder must furnish bid security for the quoted capacity.
The project must deploy the specified Solar PV technology types, with or without trackers.
Only commercially established and operational technologies may be used.
The project must achieve the specified annual CUF range.
Technical and financial bids must be submitted through the specified electronic bidding portal.
Bid security must be submitted in physical form and as a scanned copy with the technical bid.
Successful bidders must provide performance security equal to the specified percentage of estimated project cost.
The Power Delivery Agreement must be executed within the specified period after submission of the performance security.
Project commissioning must be completed within the specified period from agreement signing.
Participating bidders must submit the specified original documents by the deadline and upload scanned copies with the technical bid.
Every non-exempt bidder must furnish bid security.
Bid security must remain valid for the specified period beyond the original bid validity and applicable extensions.
Both hard-copy and online scanned-copy submission of bid-security documents are required.
Bidders must not quote deviations.
Bidders must provide complete information at submission and provide requested clarifications or documents within the specified period.
All required information must be provided in the prescribed formats.
The SPG must use the specified indigenous solar panels, modules, and cells and comply with the applicable ALMM requirements.
All components used for the solar power plants must conform to applicable BIS, MNRE, and quality-control requirements.
The SPG must provide a layout plan covering the plant and control room.
The SPG must install sufficient panels and equipment to achieve the specified annual CUF range.
The project must provide the specified ABT meters, RMS connectivity, and CT-PT arrangements.
Installation and timely replacement of meters are the responsibility of the selected SPG.
The SPG must install RMS infrastructure and provide the required API documentation.
The SPG is responsible for SIM and communication charges and must satisfy the specified connectivity and data-availability requirements.
The SPG must maintain the specified third-party liability and related insurance coverage.
